indices.title: Equity Commentary
indices.body: Both indices recovered from last week's panic driven lows. Currently ES is trading at the highs while NQ has acted a bit weaker, giving up almost the entire gap up. Price action thus remains extremely tricky going into earnings season and OPEX.

bonds.title: Bond Commentary
bonds.body: US Treasury 10Y did not make a new high overnight but still trading near highs at 5.23%. Still observing elevated risk in EU bonds.
